reviews.text:
I have been purchasing from P.C. Chandra Jewellers, since 2000 or so, and my experience with the Rajarhat store has been the same, nothing short of exceptional every single time I visit any store of PCC. Their gold quality is simply unmatched - sturdy, reliable, and built to last. Even with regular wear, their jewellery retains its shape and shine, thanks to the high standards they maintain in crafting.

Whether it’s lightweight daily wear pieces or heavy traditional jewellery, their designs are stunning and diverse. While custom orders may take up to a month or more, they are always worth the wait. Everything is hallmarked and meets the highest quality standards, which makes PCC Gold a trusted name in our family.

Their customer service is top-notch, with knowledgeable, well-trained staff who handle every transaction with care and professionalism. I’ve never faced any billing errors or confusion, and the security arrangements are excellent, offering complete peace of mind even when carrying personal gold for exchange or evaluation.

What I also love is how they make customers feel valued -invitations to events, exclusive previews, and a genuine sense of connection. P.C. Chandra is more than a brand - it’s a legacy of trust and excellence.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality, integrity, and elegance in their jewellery shopping experience!

Today, we had a wonderful experience at P. C. Chandra, Jewellers, Rajarhat outlet while purchasing a fancy Choker, Sita har, Fancy Bala 2 Nos, Fancy Chain, Sankha Badhano 2 Nos, Pola Badhano 2 Nos and Fancy Nowa etc.
All the gold items are of beautiful design, good craftsmanship and good finish.
Hospitality and the service are excellent. They have clarified each and every quirery wehave put forward to them.
The behavior and service of the following staff
1. Ms. Namrata Pal
2. Ms. Sriparna Sarker
3. Mr. Subhadip Choudhury
and last but not the least their incharge Mr. Avik Talukder are excellent. They have done an exceptional job to fully satisfying us.
We all are very happy  interacting with them.
I recommend my relatives and friends to visit at least once at P C Chandra Jewellers, Rajarhat outlet.
Excellent collection, extraordinary behaviour and lovely ambience.... Overall we always gather an excellent experience. Love PC Chandra, New Town.
Good experience. Reasonably wide variety of designs. Courteous staffs. Only problem is getting a parking space nearby. Overall, great experience
Shubhadeep and Sriparna helped me to find my dream necklace set for my wedding which perfect fit for the elegance and budget. Great experience.
